title: Tomorrow X Together
summary: This document is a comprehensive profile of Tomorrow X Together (TXT), a five-member South Korean boy band formed by Big Hit Entertainment, consisting of Yeonjun, Soobin, Beomgyu, Taehyun, and Hueningkai. The document covers the group's formation, the meaning behind their name (including its Korean transliteration and abbreviations like TXT and Tubatu), and a detailed chronological history of their career from their March 2019 debut with The Dream Chapter: Star through 2026. Key milestones detailed include their record-breaking debut on Korean and US Billboard charts, multiple album releases across Korean, Japanese, and English languages (The Dream Chapter series, Minisode series, The Chaos Chapter, The Name Chapter, and The Star Chapter), their four world tours (Act: Lovesick, Act: Sweet Mirage, Act: Promise, and Act: Tomorrow), their historic performances as the first K-pop act to perform and headline at Lollapalooza, numerous rookie awards and certifications (platinum, gold from KMCA, RIAJ, and RIAA), member activities such as MC positions and collaborations with artists like the Jonas Brothers and Anitta, their 2025 contract renewals, and their temporary hiatus announcement. The document also lists the group's members, describes their musical style blending genres like disco, shoegaze, indie rock, and pop with themes of teenage growing pains, outlines their extensive brand endorsements (including It's Skin, Skoolooks, Dior, Clio, and Dunkin' Philippines), and provides sections on their discography, filmography, concert tours and participation, and awards and nominations.
